name: Mihirini Sirisena
researchKeywords: Wider determinants of health, Equity and social justice, Mental health and wellbeing, Community-focused public health
bio:
Dr Mihirini Sirisena, PhD, is a Research Associate and member of Fuse, the Centre for Translational Research in Public Health, and the NIHR School for Public Health Research. Her work focuses on mental health and wellbeing, health inequalities, and the wider determinants of health.

Her research spans social prescribing, primary care, and community-based public health initiatives, including the CareDEEP social determinants of health pilot in Deep End North East and North Cumbria (NENC) general practices, the multi-region evaluation of social prescribing link workers, Reading for Wellbeing, and the Well Newcastle Gateshead model. Her work seeks to inform more equitable and accessible approaches to improving population health and wellbeing.
